title: pairing
description: What `stsloop-hub init` puts in its QR code, as compact JSON. Not sent over the WebSocket: the phone scans it, stores `url` and `token`, and connects to `url` with the header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

protocol.description: The newest version the hub speaks. A phone whose major is lower can still try; the hub may speak the previous major too.

url.description: The hub's WebSocket, by default on its tailnet address.

token.description: The shared secret. URL-safe base64, at least 32 characters.
